The [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] '''YZ-2500 heavy transport''' was a [[Capital ship/Legends|capital]]-scale [[Transport/Legends|transport]] that was sometimes used as a military vessel in the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:Prideofcorellia.jpg|thumb|left|150px|[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Nict]]'s ''[[Pride of Corellia]]'' is destroyed at [[Caamas/Legends|Caamas]].]]
The class had a design reminiscent of previous eras of [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] shipbuilding, with elements similar to the [[Consular-class light cruiser/Legends|''Consular''-class]] and [[DP20 gunship/Legends|DP20 frigate]].<ref name="SWL21" /> It was one of the largest space transports available on the market, and was mainly used by corporations that wanted to move large amounts of goods with a minimum amount of ships.<ref name="LECG" />

==History==
The [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] was able to produce these ships despite Imperial restrictions by convincing the Imperial bureaucracy that the YZ-2500 would help to stabilize trade lines plagued by pirates. Many of those ships found their way into the hands of [[Core Fleet|Galactic Alliance Core Fleet]].<ref name="LECG" /> A famous YZ-2500 transport was the ''[[Pride of Corellia]]'', captained by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Nict]], as a ship in the Core Fleet, during the [[Sith–Imperial War]]. The vessel was destroyed with all hands lost during the [[Battle of Caamas]].<ref name="SWL21" />
